punchline: Before his attack, Charles Whitman asked that his brain be examined; the autopsy found a tumor near his amygdala.
thirty_sec: In 1966 Charles Whitman shot people from the University of Texas tower after killing his mother and wife. He left a note asking for an autopsy, and it found a pecan-sized tumor near his amygdala. Eagleman argues biology shapes behavior unseen, though a commission could not prove the tumor caused it.
